what: Author-string -> backend person id. Built by searching GET /v2/persons, adjudicated per author, then gap-filled by BDRC id where the name search missed. `role` is the v2 ContributorRole (translator|reviser|author|scholar). `bdrc_roles_on_those_works` records what BDRC says about creators of those works, for verification -- it is NOT applied automatically.
